title: Simply Herdcraft
description: Simply Herdcraft  is an optimization modpack for 26w14a, the April Fools snapshot for the never-released Herdcraft Update.
body: Simply Herdcraft is an optimization modpack for 26w14a, the April Fools snapshot for the never-released [Herdcraft Update](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/the-herdcraft-update). ## What is 26w14a? 26w14a is one of the yearly April Fools updates for Minecraft, in which the inventory has been removed in favour of commanding your possesions around. ## Mod List + Mod Licenses Every mod in this pack has been handpicked to be compatible with 26w14a, including some custom ports. If you know/have made any mods that would fit in the pack, send them my way! - [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) by squeek502 - [Better Mount HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-mount-hud) by Lortseam - [ClickThrough Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/clickthrough+) by cassiancc - [Cloth Config](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/cloth-config) by shedaniel - [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) by RelativityMC, ishland - [Destroyer of Fabric Rendering API](https://modrinth.com/project/simply-herdcraft) by cassiancc. Custom mod licensed under CC0 - used to allow Fabric API and Sodium to coexist. - [Enchanted's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchanteds-sodium-options) by Enchanted\_Games - [Ender Christmas Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/ender-christmas+) by cassiancc - [Fabric API](https://fabricmc.net) by FabricMC - [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/fabric-language-kotlin) by FabricMC - [FerriteCore](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ferritecore-fabric) by malte0811 - [Hoofprint](https://modrinth.com/mod/hoofprint) by Garden System\. Contributions by Sisby folk - [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) by RK\_01 - [Immersive Overlays](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-overlays) by cassiancc, noelledotjpg - [LambDynamicLights](https://lambdaurora.dev/projects/lambdynamiclights) by LambdAurora - [Language Reload](https://modrinth.com/mod/language-reload) by Jerozgen - [Longview](https://modrinth.com/mod/longview) by Ennui Langeweile - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) by Prospector, haykam821, gniftygnome, TerraformersMC - [Mouse Tweaks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mouse-tweaks) by Ivan Molodetskikh \(YaLTeR\) - [No Chat Reports](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/no-chat-reports) by Aizistral - [Ok Zoomer](https://modrinth.com/mod/aXf2OSFU) by Ennui Langeweile, Up - [Open Sesame](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-sesame) by Chloe Arkwright - [Placeholder API](https://pb4.eu) by Patbox - [Reliable Recipe Viewer \(RRV\)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrv) by cassiancc, 2Bad4Mods - [Screencopy](https://github.com/imurx/screencopy) by ImUrX - [Sodium](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium) by JellySquid \(jellysquid3\) - [Surveyor Map Framework](https://modrinth.com/mod/surveyor) by Sisby folk\.
